The game lost focus, so your shift is paused.
Choose Resume when you're ready.
移动鼠标直接控制饭盒；键盘 WASD / 方向键、手柄左摇杆也能移动。到右侧饭桌: Move the mouse to steer your box, or use WASD / arrows / the left stick. At the table on the right, click / press E / A to pick up a box. Catch food and bring it back. Food earns tokens when she eats it.
每条进度对应一只独立备菜的勺子。档口显示出菜数量；多条代表同时备菜，并非食物品质: Each bar is one ladle preparing food independently. More bars mean more ladles working at once. A full bar launches food along its own path. Stall upgrades unlock more dishes.
同一饭盒凑齐菜谱原料会自动合成套餐，原料的品质收益会计入套餐价值。合成后的占格按: Matching ingredients in one box automatically form a combo. Ingredient quality contributes to its value. Each recipe has its own space cost; Context Compression saves one extra cell, down to one. Discovered recipes enter your collection.
银色为优质，散菜价值 ×2；金色为金牌，×4，FP32 解锁后 ×5。入盒后仍保: Silver dishes are worth ×2; gold dishes ×4, or ×5 with FP32. Their glow stays visible inside a box. A gold box boosts the whole meal's income. The Divergent Thinking skill attracts nearby food while thinking.
解锁后按住空格 / 右键 / B，让食物放慢，饭盒保持正常移动。结束后冷却 1: Once unlocked, hold Space / right-click / B to slow food while your box moves normally. After stopping, wait 1 second, release the button and recover at least 0.5 seconds of energy before pressing again. Markers predict where food crosses your box's height.
已吃下的主食、荤菜、素菜越接近 4∶3∶3，均衡倍率越高。青菜单吃原本会被吐掉，: Balance improves as eaten starch, meat and vegetables approach 4:3:3. She initially spits out plain greens; use combos, Prompt Injection or Grokking to handle them. Your receipt shows the income multipliers, with no hidden deductions.
解锁 Prompt 模板后，至少两份同一种散菜装满盒，也算单品拼盘，可触发多轮对: With Prompt Template, fill a box with at least two portions of one plain dish to make a platter and keep a combo chain. Context Memory rewards changing dishes between consecutive platters. Ghost food does not count; platters are not new recipes.
08 · 留点空间，下盒加餐: 08 · Leave room, boost the next box
上下文压缩解锁后，亲手送出含套餐且空至少两格的盒子，可存一份缓存。下一只亲手送出: With Context Compression, serve a box containing a combo and at least two empty cells to store a cache. Your next full box spends it for +15% income. Only one cache can be held. Helpers cannot store or spend it.
今日菜单划掉的菜不会再出，每个档口至少留一道。招牌菜的特别效果会作用于本顿饭；满: Today's Menu removes crossed-out dishes, leaving at least one per stall. Signature dishes add special effects for the next meal. When slots are full, a new pick replaces the oldest. Both settings share one panel.
Esc / P / Start 暂停；切到其他窗口默认自动暂停。回来后点击继续上: Esc / P / Start pauses your shift. Switching to another window pauses by default. Choose Resume when you return. Closing Settings or the recipe book leaves the game paused.
